messages.speaker: Alice Chen
messages.text: Good morning everyone! Let's kick off our Sprint 15 planning. I've reviewed the backlog and we have three main features to tackle this sprint.

messages.speaker: Bob Smith
messages.text: Sounds good Alice. I'm ready to take on the user authentication feature. I estimate it'll take about 3 days.

messages.speaker: Carol Davis
messages.text: Perfect. I'll handle the dashboard redesign. Should be done by Wednesday.

messages.speaker: Alice Chen
messages.text: Excellent. We decided to prioritize the authentication feature first since it's blocking the mobile team. Bob, can you have that ready by Tuesday end of day?

messages.speaker: Bob Smith
messages.text: Absolutely. I'll complete the authentication feature by Tuesday 5 PM and send the API documentation to the mobile team.

messages.speaker: Carol Davis
messages.text: I'll also update the design system documentation by Thursday. That way the team has everything they need.

messages.speaker: Alice Chen
messages.text: Great! We've also decided to move forward with the new testing framework. Carol, can you set up the initial configuration?

messages.speaker: Carol Davis
messages.text: Yes, I'll set up the testing framework by Friday morning. I'll also schedule a quick demo for the team.

messages.speaker: Bob Smith
messages.text: This sprint looks very manageable. Clear priorities and realistic timelines.

messages.speaker: Alice Chen
messages.text: Perfect! Let's reconvene on Wednesday for our mid-sprint check-in. Thanks everyone, have a productive week!
